snippet.title: JIAOHUN - World Premiere Trailer | The Triple-i Initiative
snippet.description:
Learn more about JIAOHUN: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3550940/

JIAOHUN is a cinematic first-person psychological horror game set in a small Chinese town during the 1990s. You will gradually uncover the mystery behind the downfall of Fairy Town.

You have returned here—an obscure dot on the map, Fairy Town in Baishoi County clung to survival between changing tides. As the new century approached, the town tried to adapt—but every desperate push forward failed.

JIAOHUN is scheduled for release in 2027 on PC (Steam) and PlayStation 5.

JIAOHUN Store Pages:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3550940/
PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10020536

What is the Triple-i Initiative?

We’re simply a bunch of studios banding together to share exciting news to our players, in a short show packed with back-to-back trailers. That’s it - no extra fluff, no ads, no host, just games. We’re talking world premieres, exclusive gameplay, launch dates, demo drops and more!
